implementation.budget_trend: Reads selected-year active month headers and projected task/source numeric fields in batches. Empty years skip item reads; single-task mode skips source reads. Duplicate active month headers use original per-month sheet selection; duplicate valid task indexes use the original task query/order. No cross-request cache.
implementation.budget_overview: Selected-month summary/detail reuse already-loaded task/source values and original precision rules; do not load the entire year trend. Trend charts remain in overview only; the original budget page stays hidden.
implementation.record_eligibility: Build selected-year valid task IDs, professional IDs and participating department IDs once from the original validated catalog. Filter original account order using the same active-user, valid-department and professional rules. Existing task resolution, read-scope filtering, submitted records and frozen snapshots remain unchanged. Existing catalog/department caches stay request-local.

budget_service_measurements.method: Random isolated synthetic database. Original read projection and optimized service both run inside identical read-only REPEATABLE_READ TransactionTemplate scopes. One warm-up discarded; median of five sequential samples including transaction setup. Database stores 1 then 5 years; selected year remains 2026 with 12 months and 10 task rows per month. The 5-year fixture increases stored data, not selected response size. Not HTTP, page latency, concurrent-user testing or full-system P95.

record_eligibility_cpu_measurements.method: Mock mapper fixtures, 200/1000 accounts and 120/600 valid annual tasks. Compare original per-account resolve against new eligibility calculation, including catalog processing. One warm-up discarded, median of five sequential samples. IDs and order equal. CPU-only: excludes real SQL, HTTP, rendering and concurrency.

query_evidence.applies_to: Normal unique active month/reform keys. Legacy ambiguous-key fallbacks intentionally issue extra reads. Overview count assumes the selected month exists.
query_evidence.source: BudgetTrendBatchTest and AdminOverviewQueryTest; mapper-call assertions with one SELECT per mapper method, not live SQL profiling.

compatibility_cases: All 11 task selections for 2025/2026/2029 equal original year trend maps
Zero, missing components, missing/zero budget denominator, skipped months and negative adjustments
Deleted sheets excluded; out-of-range reform indexes ignored; duplicate sheet/task keys preserve original selection
Version restoration changes current trend while retaining history; no raw import rewrite
Selected-month overview cumulative value and execution rate equal original trend month
Eligibility equals original resolution across departments, tertiary/fourth-level duties, goal phases, invalid project ancestry, inactive/deleted users, unavailable departments and empty years
Professional eligibility does not require an available own department, matching existing rules; admin testing does not enlarge expected authors
Existing draft privacy, frozen snapshots, admin delete, scope checks and ordinary task/performance/expert workflow regressions
remaining: Record summaries still perform original owner/record scope checks and materialize submitted-row details.
Core overview reads, other list projection/pagination work, initial multi-module loading and scoped summary aggregation remain unfinished.
Full-system P50/P95, sustained multi-account concurrency, scan-row tracing and index acceptance remain pending.
rollback: Restore the previous backend artifact or revert this backend commit when authorized. No new schema, index, migration, business-data update or frontend runtime change.
